text: Great service and delicious smoothies! April was patient and kind to my family and went above and beyond to make sure we had a fantastic experience!
Rude employees. Could be a little nicer to your customers than saying "yep" with an attitude when asked a question.
Great food! My son and I love Indian food- and since moving to Reno have tried several places. This is the best so far. Definitely going back

Located on the side of a gas station, this restaurant is a hidden gem. Don't let this location fool you, the food here is incredible!

Starting with the vegetarian Samosa, a pastry similar to an empanada but different in shape, was stuffed with potatoes and peas. Fabulous flavor! I also tried a bite of the veggie pakora. It was interesting, like a tempura type fried veggie.

My dinner was a shrimp curry dish, so full of flavor! Others we tried were different variations , all delicious! 

I'm definitely not an expert on Indian food, but I was fortunate to go with others that were. I'm glad I got the opportunity to try different dishes and be open minded...will definitely return for both dining in service and take out!
Their pizza is always so delicious and they are so pleasant whenever I am there to pick up! Highly recommend! Their sauce is so yummy and a nice thin crust.
Excellent location in DTSP. Great selection of local craft beer and the burgers are cooked perfectly with a lot of options.

Brunch is so good I went back the next day. I got the breakfast burrito (highly recommended and I don't even like mushrooms) and a side Ricotta Pancake (delicious)! 

The burrito comes with this AMAZING hot sauce that I wish they would bottle and sell. You are able to taste each flavor in the pancake (lemon and ricotta) without either being overbearing. 

Parking sucks and the hours are only 8-2pm but def stop by!
The wait staff is very  friendly, helpful and efficient.  The food came in a reasonable time and was timeless delicious Chinese food.  There was a variety of choices available to suit all tastes.

Ok...I MUST update my review on this place because we have been here so many times and never have been disappointed since our second visit. The 4 star went to 5 in our book since they have a different server and but food has always been spot on. The young lady that waits on the tables is very friendly and has a great personality. My mom, my boys and I LOVE their food here. You can tell that it is NOT made ahead and it is FRESH. Their Greek Salad is by far the BEST one we have ever had. Hands down. My mom and I always get the larger portion with fish for hers on the side and I really like their chicken shawarma. OMG! I have yet to try any of the desserts, but we will one of these days. If you like Greek food...THIS IS THE PLACE...forget those chain restaurants!

The food is absolutely delicious. I have tried 4 different pastas and enjoyed every single one of them. Way better than Olive Garden and the prices are great. They serve beer, wine, pizza, pasta, desserts. All of their pastas come with a huge salad, and the ranch or blue cheese is homemade dressing and finger licking good. I'd highly recommend this restaurant to anyone, and it's local! Try it out! You won't be disappointed!

UPDATE: 6/7/2020 So I wanted to order takeout but literally every app was giving me problems. I called the restaurant in between attempts and each time Michelle was super patient and helpful. I was determined not to be deterred, I had my mouth set on a meal from SOUTH tuhday! In my final attempt, the manager got on the phone to troubleshoot with me and she too was so patient and so helpful, she was able to figure out the issue and she helped me to navigate the app so that I could place my order. As an awesome thank you gesture, the owner threw in some extra treats. And when I say everything was good, E-VER-Y-Thing was goodt! it felt like thanksgiving in June. And I was especially thankful that the food came in foil pans so that everything can be reheated in the oven. LOVE!LOVE!LOVE! SOUTH

I was impressed by the wide selection of delectable and adorably cute cakes this place has. Animals, plants, and more traditional looking cakes as well. I tried the tiramisu plant, and was not disappointed. Very tasty. It really looked like a potted plant, in a plastic container that resembled a terra cotta pot.

Can't wait to try more!
My first time going to Saigon Bistro. The food is delicious. Will definitely be coming back again?
Just not my kind of pizza. Everything falls off when you eat it. Nothing more to say. And the waitress wire no mask.

La Cucina Italian Eatery has a bistro vibe combined with fine dining service. I imagine it would be perfect for a business lunch, with salads, sandwiches, pizza, and pasta. But it's also a very welcoming environment for a family dinner, including a kids menu.

While deciding on entrees, we were served a couple loaves of warm, herbed bread, with a mix of olive oil and balsamic vinegar for dipping. I followed this with a shared bottle of chianti ($24), a cup of portabella mushroom cream soup ($4), and a couple orders of sauteed provolone ($9, three pieces each). The flavor of the completely pureed soup was good, but I was disappointed with its lack of discernible 'shrooms. Our appetizer featured large, thick slices of cheese--fried crispy in butter, garlic, and white wine--topped with a sautee of sun-dried tomato, and pine nuts. An excellent pairing with the light, fruity vino.

A plate of porcini and truffle ravioli ($16) included a mushroom demi-glace cream sauce, and the mushroom chunks I'd hoped to find in the soup. There was just a hint of truffle, which amplified the porcini with great effect. As a dedicated fungi fan, I had to restrain the desire to sample more of my daughter-in-law's meal than necessary.

My daughter ordered off-menu with a nest of angel hair alfredo ($15), while her boyfriend tried his first-ever bowl of spaghetti alla bolognese with meatballs ($15.50). The butter, cream, and parmesan alfredo sauce was very smooth, holding onto the capellini noodles be

The chicken was good, portions were good; loved the service... but the restaurant was colder than a witches titty in a brass bra. 

You can tell by the tremendous traffic of
Hard working men with the little mesh trucker hats and Carhartt sweaters that this place will satisfy the needs of the hard working middle class that always stand up and salute and always recognize

Starting with their very detailed and up-to-date online ordering system to pick-up to the food, I was impressed. So many of the delivery services are missing ingredient detail and customization options, but going direct to The Food Liaison's site was wonderful.
This restaurant serves an awesome burger but didn't care much for some of the sides offered. Wish they would serve more typical sides such as french fries. The atmosphere is good!
Excellent service. Food exceeded expectations. Unusual dishes I would have never tried but glad I did. The blue crab spaghetti was wonderful.

McDonalds will always be... okay..? I guess. Well, we ventured on over to try their international items. The Stroopwafel McFlurry was awesome, just make sure you mix that thing up! All the waffle bits at the bottom. The Grand Mc Extreme Bacon burger was insanely good. I didn't expect MD to throw it down like that, but they did! 10/10 must try. The tomato mozzarella chicken sandwich was a 6/10, wasn't anything crazy. The Cheesy Bacon fries were good, wish they cooked the fries longer tho. All in all, McFlurry and bacon burger and your good to go.

Not crowded on a Wednesday afternoon around lunchtime, which had me a bit worried. Restaurant looks very clean and service was fantastic. We were given complimentary soup and a crab rangoon, which was very good. Tried the curry potstickers appetizer, next. The potstickers are good and crispy and the curry sauce was very nice. My entree was BBQ pork fried rice, which was excellent and didn't need any additional seasoning or soy sauce. The lunch portion was more than enough for one sitting. I'll return here, when in the area, for sure.

Made a reservation at another restaurant that evening and got a call less than an hour before to tell us that they cancelled our res as there was a gas line problem on the block - no hot food.  Punted and called Royal Boucherie and got an immediate reservation and boy, so glad we did.  The food was phenomenal, especially the oysters and cocktails.  Staff was excellent and accommodating.  Would go back again in a heartbeat next time we are back in Philadelphia.

Wow! Yah Mon is relatively close to me, so I can't believe I didn't discover it until I saw it on Yelp. My family and I went for the first time tonight, and the experience was absolutely amazing. Their specialty drinks and juices are delicious and have great depth of flavor. I ordered the jerk chicken, and my parents tried the Caribbean Chicken Platter (featuring stew chicken, jerk chicken, and curry chicken). Both dishes come with rice & beans, a side salad, and plantains. All of the food was delicious, and the chicken was incredibly tender (I could cut it with my fork). Almost all of their menu is gluten free, and I also saw vegetarian options listed on the menu. Andre provided outstanding service, and I enjoyed the decor as well. If you are concerned about price, know that the portions are very hearty. I have a second meal's worth of jerk chicken waiting for me for lunch tomorrow (and I can't wait!).

I love McNamara's! The food is always prepared quickly. It's so yummy and comforting. I always get the corned beef and cabbage with mashed potatoes with gravy. One of these days I might try something else but I'm usually craving this when we visit. My husband has tried a variety of items on the menu and always devours them. The desserts are good too. They are huge so prepare to share.
The staff is friendly and attentive. The bands are great! It's a very friendly, welcoming atmosphere.

This is my go to when I want fresh and pizza served up just the way I want it! Most the time you are greeted very pleasantly. The ambience is nice and they even have a small patio if you want to enjoy the warm evenings outside.

Really wanted to like this place after hearing great things. But, my order just wasn't good. I ordered the Rize upside down or inside out pizza and the cheese was a thick layer of hardness that we could barely bite through and there was no sauce on it.
The ribeye egg rolls weren't good either. 
Two things that were good were the beet salad and the truffle fries. I am hesitant to try again. My sister ordered before and loved it then ordered the same day that we did and said it wasn't good either, maybe they had an off night or have a new cook?

Took a day trip with friends to Carp and found this place on yelp and am glad I went with it. The restaurant has an adorable set up and great food. I was scared I wouldn't find a good vegetarian option but was impressed with the Buffalo Cauliflower appetizer and the veggie burger with sweet potato fries. A man with glasses who appeared to be a manager was very attentive and friendly to my table. I would come here again next time I visit

Awesome!

Steak was cooked to perfection, my wife's fish was exceptional.  

Seared immediately, super great and friendly service. 

Couldn't be happier!

The food was delicious but the atmosphere & safety were lacking. Three employees sat behind us talking loudly about personal issues. No employees were wearing masks. I would advise take out only - definitely not dining in.

Good service, clean & easy parking.
One of my favorite here is the green tea cream, their teas taste good. 
But the sweet level is a bit too much for me, 
I'll order 75 or even 50% sugar.
And the boba is a bit hard in the center.

I had a their burger it was good. And my girl had mai mai sandwich. We did wait one hr and a half. Even though it was cold it was worth the wait. Plus we waited to be seated on the top deck.  We could been seated early. But it was a bday weekend for my girl and I just tough through it. Check this place out if you like seafood and a good burger. People did get take out .

Don't eat here. Ghetto and don't food is sloppy. They need to shut this down. Don't eat here. Ghetto and don't food is sloppy. They need to shut this down. Don't eat here. Ghetto and don't food is sloppy. They need to shut this down

We had an excellent dinner at Ximena's Mexican on a low key and rainy Wednesday night. The owner was very friendly and gave us time to study the extensive menu. Fresh corn chips and and homemade salsa were complimentary and a nice touch. 

Tried both their delicious melon agua fresca and the horchata. We enjoyed some authentic chicken enchiladas in green sauce and the daily special; green mole chicken. Both were served with a side of pinto beans and rice. The individual tacos were also a nice option, especially when you're in a hurry. This is a great addition to the neighborhood and I'm happy to support their bus

Been wanting to visit this place for awhile now and it did not disappoint. The food is excellent, the hot sauce is a perfect balance of hot yet flavorful, and the beer is cold and big. This place left me feeling no pain.

I'm very surprised at some of the ratings for NOSH. This place is a hidden gem that gives you so much bang for your buck. I love love love the concept. The atmosphere is warm and inviting. Very comfy seating. Overall a very relaxed vibe. 

I went with my best friend on a Caliente night (Thursday). We had tacos, oysters, poke, shrimp eggrolls and probably some other stuff that I'm missing. It was all super delicious and very shareable. I was extremely impressed with the oysters, and the eggrolls. They were done excellently. 

The cocktails we had were great (special shoutout for the jalapeno strawberry margarita - just the right amount of spice!). The servers were friendly and conversational and didn't yell at us for relaxing outside in their chairs before they opened. (THANK YOU) 

Great place - even though we had small plates, we were full by the time we left. There's so much deliciousness to try! 

5 Stars - great atmosphere, friendly staff, delicious food!
Wasn't what we were expecting.  Basically upscale fast food.  Meal was served in non- eco friendly styrofoam.  Food was ok for what it was, but just nothing special.  We probably will not return.

We actually ordered Pizza Luna for our wedding "dinner." We eloped, and it was just our family joining us. It was seriously delicious. They aren't stingy with toppings, and the crust is crunchy perfection!

I took my son to Ice Point Cafe today for lunch.  We ordered poke bowls, bubble tea and a smoothie.  All were delicious!  Bright and cozy atmosphere.  Owners super nice and friendly!  I would recommend to all who enjoy a healthy alternative to fast food.
Order was 2 hrs late.  And an Italian sandwich short.  One hour later the Italian sandwich arrives and with chunk ham. Really!!! It has cut up canned ham in chunks on an Italian sub.
WOW we just moved to Reno and are checking out places for the first time...this is a MUST for anyone looking for incredible service, spectacular food, and a great atmosphere!

Best Pho in town. My husband and I ate lunch an ordered veggie spring rolls,  vegetarian pho and another soup which was like the hot and sour.
The spring rolls were fresh, the pho was amazIng!! Flavorful and veggies cooked to perfection. The other soup was unique and tasted delicious. The service was great and the server was attentive. 
Will definitely be  back.
My yiro was DRY!!!!!! I got my food delivered and I received no napkins, utensils and no ketchup to go with the 2 orders of fries. Annoying.
Cool concept of pouring beer by yourself, helpful personnel, and it's tasty! We had to wait a little bit for a table but not for too long.

Very good food. I met my girlfriend here and such good food with great service. We sat at the bar, it was consistent service. We both started with refreshing mojitos. We went for the oysters so we ordered the chargrilled oysters which was very good and flavorful. Tasty butter and cheese get me every time! I ordered the seafood risotto, it was very flavorful and fresh. It's a little rich for me so I couldn't eat the entire meal but of course I had enough for leftovers! We ended the night out with these delicious almond and coconut truffles. The ambiance to the food and service, great place to dine out. Beautiful entrance and a great view of the river. There is many places to sit that would fit your desire. Outdoors or indoors. I will definitely return!

While it is arguable whether Los Arroyos is the best Mexican restaurant in town, it is no doubt that they are a contender in any debate. In my opinion they are the best tostada salad 'Tostada Ranchera' in town hands down. I like both the chicken and steak options and rarely rotate out of that selection.  Oh, and gotta get the cilantro sauce. They have a good specials board and okay variety of burritos. The kids are usually happiest with a Johnny's burrito.  I am happy that they now offer free chips with the in house order (paying for that was the bummer for years). The salsa bar is fresh and offers a nice variety. I always like a roasted jalapeno and some limes to fire up my 'salad'. Do not forget your punch card! It is always good to get a free meal after some visits
My husband and I came here last year for our anniversary trip and we had to come back again this year. This charming restaurant is definitely one of our favorites. Yummy breakfast and great staff.
I love the vibe- so cool when we walked in. We have drinks - we all love apple drink -sss00000 good. The waitress was helpful and stylish!

This place is SO GOOD!!! Went yesterday for the first time and am already thinking of when I can go back. The chicken burrito was so delicious and big enough to split with someone. Great atmosphere, too. This was the best meal I've had in awhile. Will be returning ASAP.

We had reservations for 8. Got there at 7:55 ish. They said they had to get the table ready so we went and sat at the bar to wait. 30 minutes later they still hadn't sat us or gave us an update and we saw another table of 2 get sat right as they walked in. Left and went across the street...
This spot is terrible. Was in town visiting family. Horrible service, horrible attitude and terrible food.

Full disclosure: I used to work here. Some thoughts:

-There is not a healthier place to eat in St. Louis.
-A great place to work.
-A great place to hang out.
-Good music.
-Good yoga.
-Try the raw cookies (maple maca, raw brownies).
-An evolving mini-shop up front with vegan lip balm, books, vegan yogurt, etc.!

Just go there and see for yourself! :)

I came to whiskey Roads tonight for the third week in a row and the DJ tonight was not up to Par. I went up and requested Foot Loose by Blake Shelton and he said that it was coming up. I have been here since 7:30 and have not once heard Footloose. A DJ should be accommodating and listening to its audience.  It's 12am almost 5 hours later and I haven't heard it. Unacceptable.

The summer rolls here are incredible. So fresh and crunchy, with the slight chewiness of the wrapper, and two great sauces. I could probably eat it as a light ish lunch entree since the tofu adds a good dose of vegetarian protein. 

The chicken banh mi is my favourite thus far, ever. (Admittedly I've only had banh mi maybe a half dozen times in the past, but still!) Great quality bread, delicious pickled veggies, and fantastic sauce. It even held up as leftovers the following day!

The pho is made with chicken broth which is rare and welcome! I maybe am not the biggest fan of any broth based soup but could still appreciate it. 

I usually also get the thai iced tea which is good. And the fried cheesecake is a rare treat. 

I see a lot of people ordering seafood and seem to enjoy it...lots on the menu.
The chicken and shrimp Pad Thai was very flavorful with just a mild touch of heat. So glad to have found this little gem so close to home; I will be back!

When I hear words like fresh pressed juices, smoothies, organic and cafe, I immediately begin envisioning the worst. My experiences with restaurants dropping those terms have not been great. What else has not been great? Religious based restaurants. 

These worlds collide at Revelations Cafe and, because of that, I really wasn't in a hurry to visit. But my wife received a couple coupons to the cafe and, well, we gave it a go. My expectations were low but I entered with as open of a mind as I could muster.

Revelations Cafe quickly proved that history doesn't have to repeat. The employees were amazing and accommodating. They made recommendations and talked to me about some of the decisions they made about vegan items. For instance, I asked what vegan cheese they use. The man behind the counter said Violife. He then added they did their homework and it was the only vegan cheese that was any good (I agree!). He also said their vegan chicken was Gardein brand (my favorite!). 

Between the four of us (my wife, two kids and I) we ordered the Vegan Buffalo Chicken Wrap, the Acai Bowl, a Kid's Grilled Cheese, a Kid's Mozzarella Flatbread, Hummus and Pita and a fresh pressed juice.

The Buffalo Chicken Wrap was incredible. It had some fresh veggies on it along with the vegan mozzarella, chicken and buffalo sauce. The plate was drizzled with some vegan ranch. I loved this because I don't normally eat ranch and I've found at other places my idea of a tiny bit is different than their's.
Went today after seeing the place on the news station. I tried 1/2 a Meatloaf and 1/2  Cinque Terre was so delicious. I'd recommend Yosh's to anyone

This was the second stop on our Broadway tour and I LOVED Nudie's! It wasn't planned or scheduled but every time we walked by the music was fan-freakin-tastic and loud - there's no way we could keep passing by without going in. It was crowded, even at 2pm on a weekday, but we were able to snag a couple seats at the bar. The bartenders were friendly and served up drinks quickly. Every band that played was amazing and super engaging with the crowd.

It's a narrow space (not as narrow as Tootsie's) with a long bar so there's still plenty of space. We enjoyed downstairs so much that we actually didn't make our way to the other floor(s?)

We're staying in the area for just a few days and tried La Casa on the strength of reviews here. Very unassuming from the outside and inside, but both the food and service were excellent. I had enchiladas poblanos (with mole) and he had tacos al pastor. We would definitely come back.

An amazing selection of cooked food and grocery delights , fresh meats , cheeses,pastas and seafood for any palate. Well worth the trip for a great breakfast , lunch or dinner or the finest foods to create a wonderful meal.

I've been to this quaint ladies-day-out cafe two times in two weeks. Lovely both times.  The first time I tried the Vegetarian Tomato Basil Bisque which I found to have an unpleasant raw taste to the tomatoes.  I ordered the Handcrafted Roast Beef
with boursin and vidalia onion jam served on warm naan with leaf lettuce and garden tomato which was delicious. The second time I stopped in I enjoyed the 
Santa Fe ovengold turkey breast, melted pepperjack, applewood smoked bacon, garden tomato, tropical fruit salsa and greens tucked in a sun-dried tomato tortilla with a side kale salad. This sandwich was delightful too. The kale salad appeared to be topped with store-bought julienned carrots.  The fresh fruit side would have been a better choice I'm sure.  Each friend ordered the quiche with a side of fruit and loved it.

They have breakfast and a weekend brunch available too. The mimosas are tempting for sure. 

The service is laid back and everyone is extremely friendly. The tables are cute with a little vase of flowers on the table  (they look real!).  You can choose either inside or outside dining.  You sign the register at the hostess station upon ariving and there is seating available while you wait for your table; be sure to go look in the little bakery in the back with greeting cards, small gifts and prepared food to purchase, too.

The parking lot is an easy in and out. Watch for the cafe though because it is easy to miss the first time. And I have to mention the ladies r

This was my first time here and I ordered the rainbow bowl for around $11 in the smallest size, very disappointed in how small the portion was considering the price. There are many other places in the area that offer acai that give you your money's worth. My bowl's acai was not even filled 1/4 way to the top, normally the acai blend itself is the base rather than the very small amount I received. Although the fruit was fresh and the blend tasted fairly yummy, I would recommend going elsewhere (Sweet Soul!!) due to the incredibly small amount of food you get. Definitely not worth it.

Been here twice now. When it's busy the service can be kinda slow and hectic but the employees are always polite and accommodating. 

The food tho...I SAID GODDAMN. Yeah, it's pretty good. The bbq chicken has infiltrated my dreams and now I'm fiendin' for it. The beef, kalbi ribs, Mac salad and rice is all delicious. Huge portions on everythang. My girlfriend had the poke bowel and that was good too. 

The bakery side had me feeling all kinds of nostalgic. My aunt was always stocked up with those Hawaiian drinks and Diamond Bakery crackers. 

I'm a fan and can't wait to go back.

A favorite place to stop by with my little pup on a Sunday afternoon. LUCA eats is a genuine neighborhood treasure. The pressed sandwiches are always on point, with reasonable prices and tasty ingredients, but what I like best is the service. The folks behind the counter always seem genuinely delighted to see you!

This is the place to be in New Orleans heat!  Good air conditioning, amazing social distancing, and warm welcoming staff.  Our server Tink was hands down the best I've had in a while and certainly the best we've had on this trip!  She was so attentive, and amazingly helpful with my friend who is gluten free.  She went to the chef and came up a whole menu of options for my friend.  Truely top class.  Planning on coming back everyday until we leave to see her.  Just the best service you could ever ask for.  I literally love her.  This restaurant was also amazing!  She was the double cherry on top!

Great simple breakfast.  It was like eating from Grandma's house. We stopped in on our morning walk and ordered take out. The staff is EXTREMELY nice!!!   Please go and support--it's in a great location.  Near Jackson Square

Decent portions, more tasty than not but... VERY heavy handed with the salt. We had the tri tip sandwich -- salty, and the fries were so salty they were inedible. A shame to have wasted so much food because of this but if you're thinking of ordering anyway remember to say "easy on the salt."

I forgot all about this place on Taco Tuesday. I came here a few times before and the service was a hit or miss. But after speaking with a guy name Tony last night he reassured me that things would run smoothly from now on, which I really appreciated. And let me tell you the tacos were like no other. Didn't take long to come out at all, it also came with a nice amount of beef and shrimp and some really good salsa on the side. Beef tacos are $2 as well, can't beat that ‍. I would definitely be getting tacos from here more often!
Suuuper tasty with the friendliest service on a porch on a sunny December Florida day.  Heavenly
I absolutely love the Swedesboro dining. Even with COVID-19 restrictions they still serve takeout and it's almost as good as eating in! Can't wait to sit at their tables they have outside

Great food and great service. The Brussels sprouts are a have to order, and the steak is amazing!

The perfect place if you are looking for an special occasion or a date.

the people are really nice and i feel bad for writing a bad review but i've been to so many sushi restaurants and thai restaurants and this by far was the worst. the sushi was rolled awfully and was super squishy and my fried rice tasted like nothing

I've been coming here for about a year now and have NEVER had a bad meal. The food is always so fresh. The salsa bar is such a nice touch too. The mango salsa is absolutely amazing! I wish I knew how to make it! 

The staff is always very friendly and welcoming. There is hardly a wait time for the order to be completed, maybe 10 mins max. We generally order the same thing, but the Diablo Burrito w/shrimp is amazing and the Ultimo. I'm not a fan of the Baja burrito, since it's cold inside. But, to eachs own.
Dirty and gross. Very sad that this chain sanctions this location. Menu was sticky, bar was disgusting, and restrooms sad

Good Colombian food, in a clean establishment. Waitress could have been a little more attentive (water glass was almost empty with no offer to refill...at all) since we were the only ones there... and our house salad was brought out 60 seconds before the entree. Docking a star for those reasons. Overall a nice little place and the food was well cooked, had an authentic taste and came out hot....but overall was just average. I did expect a larger portion though as I've been to many Colombian restaurants. Docked another star for those two reasons.
Wonderful service, absolutely delicious food. Also, very vegan friendly. I can't wait to go back.
Had their pepperoni cheddar Pierogie twice and they are always so delicious.  Bought some frozen cheddar and onion Pierogie once again very tastee will be a return customer for sure.

I've ordered takeout from them before and not had problems but this time there was a big mixup in the food despite being verified over the phone and in person when I came to pick up my order.

The only thing correct was the pineapple stir fry but it had the wrong meat and zero spice. The other entree was some sort of vegetarian rice dish with no spice and no meat. I had ordered pad thai with shrimp and chicken. I didn't discover the mixup with this dish until today, the day after.

If you do get pickup, visually verify your order before leaving with it. Whoever got my spicier dishes, I hope you like heat ...

As an abandoned child who was found on the side of the road by a pack of wolves and raised as one of their own, I have a fierce wild hunger for meats and a desire to find my pack.

My visit to Monell's satisfied all of my needs. 

Seated around a huge table with my mate and 10 other people ravenously waiting for food to be  served, we asserted our dominance by pouring ice tea for the strongest members at the table before letting the weaklings have the scraps.

Then the feast began. Cornbread, rolls, corn pudding (never had this before but definitely a highlight), green beans, & mashed potatoes were all served with fried chicken, meatloaf, catfish and more! Unlimited portions are perfect for a leader of a pack like myself. 

Although $25/person price is nothing to howl at, I'm definitely fueled and ready to go down for a nap in the den.

P.S. I love you.

I had reservations for my sister and I at 1pm.  We were seated promptly in a booth. One of the seats seemed to have lost all of the springs and was a bit uncomfortable. Our waitress Hope said the booth seats were on order.
We ordered drinks first and then dinner and apps.  ( crab lumpchop, corn and crab soup, salads and the special that we shared, cowboy ribeye with a side of Brussel sprouts). 
We were told the steak was a 24 oz steak which is why we decided to share.  I have attached the  I pic of the steak. 
I was not impressed by the size, flavor, preparation or grade of beef. We ordered the steak Medium. And it was slightly under. I soldiered through but my sis asked that her steak to be cooked a bit more.  And of course it came back well done!
I am only visiting so I may return for the happy hour but my standards were a bit high since the steak was $44. I have had better steak for less at outback.
The staff is always friendly and the soup is always delicious! I recently tried a couple other items such as the Mac which was heavenly.
Veekoo serves the best fish and sushi in the Philadelphia region.

Food was fair at best. The chicken cutlet sandwich tasted like the chicken was not fresh. Small shrimp on the salad with few vegetables. Salads were to come with either a bottle of water or can of soda. When I asked I was told no.  Not cheap and we finished lunch hungry. One and done. Sorry.
I only need to say excellent service, food and very clean that's hard to see in this days. Like the McDonald across the street is so dirty and full of lazy people including the managers.

This place was absolutely perfect. Adorable setting with quick service.  I got the raw veggie wrap and it was unlike any other raw wrap I've tried! Perfectly balanced and structurally sound.  Would definitely come here again.

Ate lunch here a couple of days ago...we had fish tacos with pico de gallo and a tuna sandwich on marble rye bread with lettuce tomato cucumber and onion...tacos and salsa were excellent...the marble rye bread for the tuna sandwich was super fresh...great lunch...friendly staff...highly recommend.

Super friendly owners. Ordered the Kani salad which was different from others I have had. Definitely has a kick to it which I enjoyed, but was a bit too heavy on the mayo. Good size rolls, not too much rice. Had the tuna and Alaska rolls. Would go back and try other menu items. Interested to see what this little place grows into!

Great wings, HORRIBLE pizza! Obviously frozen, had black, burnt, crusty stuff all of the bottom of crust. Tasted downright gross. The bartender was clearly intoxicated and every time he served our beers (my boyfriend getting drafts, mine in bottles) they foamed over so bad it was just ridiculous. If the wings weren't as good as they were this place would be getting 1 star rated for sure.

They need to open one in Sacramento!!! I love this place. Everytime I'm in Reno, I stop by lol.

Their chicken is sooo good like I dont know what they put it in but DAMN!!! Maybe it's their sauce too that makes it even better. I always get their combos and sub coleslaw for another toast. Omg their toast is bomb too!! Ugh, everything is just so delicious here!

Great creole food. My wife & I went here for the first time as we've heard great things above the joint. I ordered the bbq shrimp and my wife ordered the seafood platter. The bbq was filled with shrimp and it was pretty tasty. My wife said the best thing about her meal was the coleslaw. She raved about it the entire meal. Overall, the place was a good choice. Very laid back, local folks place. Would recommended for sure.

This has become my favorite breakfast in the Treasure Valley.  
When you go, plan on a wait, but it's worth it.  Grab a game, cards, etc that they have available and enjoy the time with whoever you're with.
Everything that we have had here has been delicious.  Whether it's been my wife and I or the entire family, everyone has been happy (and that's not always easy).
Can't wait to go back.

Thank you for taking proper safety cautions! We ordered in through door dash and with our order we ordered  a drink along with a meal and we received a mason jar that was TAPED to seal. Thank you for this. Genuinely appreciate this business and 10/10 recommend coming here for a meal

This place is a very cool vibe, fancy/club-ish. They have a DJ at night. I have been here before for drinks. One of my favs is the "spice on ice", very refreshing and spicy, I love it! 
Last night we stopped in for a quick appetizer while waiting on a table at another restaurant lol. We ordered the potato fondue with fresh veggies. This was shockingly so stinking good!!! Very smooth and silky and very fresh veggie dippers. I want to eat this again. And I had the "tryst" signature cocktail. Another very good drink. Fresh and you can taste the alcohol, not weak. This place definitely has never disappointed me. Next time I'll have to try more food also!

My family's new favorite place to order from. The food is always delicious and hot when delivered. Love the wings they are the best in town! We don't have a menu so it's a little inconvenient passing my phone around so everyone can pick their order. Other than that it's great we highly recommend it.

Spent months looking forward to coming here but the service was terrible and the food was wildly overpriced.  When we arrived all tables were taken or still needed bussed but we needed to stay near the register to hear our order being called so we stood for about 15 minutes holding fountain drinks that were sweating everywhere and finally decided to set them down on the bar while we waited.  As soon as we did that more employees appeared out of nowhere to lecture us on city ordinances about standing at the bar rather than notice there was literally no place for us to sit.  The employees began arguing over who should bus the tables and after we finally sat the place cleared out.  We waited another 15 minutes in a practically empty restaurant wondering why one hot dog, one burger and one order of fries could possibly take this long.  An employee approached us and said "Your name wouldn't happen to be ____, would it?" and I said "Yes it is".  He went over and yelled at the employee who wouldn't bus the table earlier and then he brought over our food which clearly had been sitting awhile and was now cold.  I wanted to ask for food that was actually hot but the way these employees behaved made me worry it would result in someone sabotaging my food if I dared to resemble an actual customer.  Annoyed that it cost me $40 and I tipped 20% before any of this went down but honestly wished I would've just gotten all of my money back and left.  There was also no toilet paper in the bathro

This is my neighborhood grocery store... for at least 25 years!!! Handy since it's really close to home. However, if they keep changing their products (by Eliminating Favorites), I will start looking elsewhere!
Used to be able to count on "my neighborhood Store", but not any more... 
So Sad. I miss the stuff I always used to get in the deli too..
If it ain't broke, don't mess with it!
Found this little place in old town Smyrna TN this weekend. The service was great and the food was excellent as well. Wasn't too crowded so service was fast and attentive. Would certainly go back!

I just sat on the sweet patio for 30 minutes with no service.  I was handed a menu, ordered a drink, and then nothing else ever happened....  the menu looked awesome, but I have no idea about anything else - or the phantom drink that I ordered.  I just finally left...

We worked with Lisa in ordering cookies for our cookie table for our October wedding. The cookies were absolutely incredible and our guests kept complimenting how delicious they were! It was so easy to order, and they were able to make the cookies slightly smaller so guests could take home in bags. We couldn't recommend them more - for an event or just a sweet treat!
Two words. Yum Eee! A little pricey but really consistent, quality Thai food. Would recommend to a friend and then eat all their food.

The food here is absolutely delicious! The burrata pizza is so good it is unreal! The burrata appetizer is awesome, too. Still, our favorite is the Bianca pizza. If you like blue/ gorgonzola cheese GET IT. Tonight we had the eggplant "meatballs" with sage polenta which was on special. SO TASTY. We've also had some seafood here and it was quite good but the vegetarian options have been the best so far. Cute outdoor seating but it's beautiful inside, too. This is one of our favorite restaurants in Indianapolis!

The one time i finally decide to review this place the food was horrible. We use to come here all the time and loved everything we got but last night was a different story. We arrived close to 9pm on a Tues and got greeted and seated right away which was never a problem when we come to Cheddars we rarely have to wait long. Got seated and the waitress greeted us and took our drink order and then she came back with our drinks and we placed our orders. 

Note they changed their menus and took some stuff off. No big deal so we went with what we got before so i got the New Orleans pasta and my boyfriend got the fried shrimp with loaded baked potatoe and green beens. We got our food in a timely manner. So we said our grace and dug right in. Ugh the food was just not good. The shrimp had too much batter and it was hard, the green beans was on the sweeter side and my pasta just didn't taste the same. We was so disappointed!!! He ate all the baked potatoe and drank his club soda and nibbled on some of the shrimp, and i barely ate my pasta but my fruit tea waa good. Almost $40 with gratuity we was not satisfied! They went up on their price too it seems and somehow manage to not make their food fresh made to order. To be a scratched made food it sure didn't feel like it. My boyfriend said the shrimp almost tasted like captain d's. Well we won't be returning. We didn't complain to the waitress we just paid our tab still left a good tip and then left.

I've been digging Le Caves doughnuts since I was a child, it was originally located on 6th Avenue and 22nd. Now on 22nd and Alvernon  The glazed we amazing. Today was a special that it you buy a coffee they give you a free doughnut. They were amazing. My only issue is the hired help. Julianna was so uninviting. That's why I gave it 3 stars. Attitude definently makes a difference.  Maybe she is having a Monday morning moment.  I'll try again and hope her attitude us more serviceable.
Nice outdoor area to enjoy on a sunny day. Appreciated the selection of food items to go with the beers we ordered.
I kept hearing nothing but good things about Tank & Libby's and I'm so glad I finally went. Friendly staff, service was great and the food was amazing!! My new favorite spot.

My go to sushi place. Get the wholly roll, chefs special roll for must haves. The avocado deluxe isn't bad and the beef tatAki is gangsta, if you like Pittsburgh rare meat that is. Miss the noodles when you went in restaurant to eat and the yellowtail neck only good sit down. Hands down good overall sushi

We are traveling in our RV across the country and are staying at a local campground. I found Awedaddys on Yelp and knew we had to try it. We waited 15-20 minutes for a table, but that was ok because we walked to the marina and listened to the music. Once sat we had ABBY as our server. She was great! She was personable and a great waitress. I had Shrimp and Grits, my Mom had the Cajun pasta and my hubby had grilled shrimp, it was all delicious. We will be back next time we are in the area.
Corn dogs were lukewarm. Large drink was half full. Staff was wearing masks and gloves.

I've ordered the Sicilian cheer pizza from here a few times . I was really disappointed the fact that they don't have any beef sausage options when I called to inquire bc we don't eat pork . I was told they had ground beef but bc it was for the burgers you would have to pay for a burger lol some I'd be paying $8 for a beef or non pork topping . That doesn't sound unreasonable at all . The Sicilian pizza is already a steep price alone . Hopefully they add more topping options in the future. 
With that said I enjoy the wings and the pizza but opt not to go here when I'm not in the mood for plain cheese pizza.

I hosted a small post-wedding brunch at Josephine Estelle the morning after my wedding. We were placed on a set, smaller menu due to the size of our group but everything was SO delicious. We had a variety of appetizers such as salad, baked goods, chicken biscuits, breakfast sandwiches, and parfaits. This was already more than enough food but in addition each of us got to pick an entree too! All for a very reasonable per person price. The ambiance of this restaurant is super fun & cool, and I definitely would recommend for a brunch time event. Can't wait to return to try more menu items!

We went to 2 different locations this one was by far the worst we didn't even get to eat.  The restaurant was half empty and there was over an hour wait?? Same thing for the Anticooch location.  You people need to get your shet together.

This place was excellent. Service was spot on, food was amazing. Ribs were tender, tasty and juicy. Pulled pork was excellent. And to the reviewers that complained about the credit charge fee...   get over it. You sound pathetic. The fee was around 1.60 on a 57 dollar bill. So stupid to give 1 star for. Excellent experience and food. Will be back.
Beat chicken spedini I have had in St Louis ever.  Good staff. Great burgers, especially juicy lucy.

I have been a customer at Mangia since I was 16. I've seen lots of owners come and go. Idk who is running it now, but the last couple of years the service is just awful. I am not one to give a bad review because of one bad experience. It makes me sad to see what it's turned into. You wait and wait and wait just to be recognized at the bar and they act like they are doing you a favor by serving you. This is the last time. I waited for over 15 minutes and the bartender never came to get my drink order. There were literally 5 customers including myself. There is no excuse for that kind of service.

Very very very good. My wife and I decided to come here because it was on axxess. No expectation but left blown away! Rachel helped us and was great!  She was friendly, quick and attentive. She was the only one holding down the front and was professional and patient the whole time, even with a line. The food is also excellent and the smallest amount was still a lot. Happy hour every day 2 to 5 and I loved my spicy taco and the choices of drinks are mind-blowing.

Bonus points: Rachel recognized that I had the new S10 (+). And this place got bonus points because of that! Considering I just got this phone 2 days ago.
Original ownership changed Recently to a corporate owned store. it was always a solid sandwich and today it was also a solid sandwich. The cole turkey hit the spot and will be back!

Volo is my favorite coffee shop in the area. They serve la Colombe coffee with amazing food and have very friendly staff. Their iced coffee, regular coffee, and lattes are amazing. Their breakfast paninis, lunch paninis, and fresh pastries never disappoint. I recommend the caprese panini and the bacon egg and cheese panini. If you're in the area I'd definitely recommend to stop by.

My family had a few things on the menu, and everything was amazing! We had first timer falafel eaters, and a seasoned vet. Everyone loved it! Fresh authentic food made from scratch, great price, and high quality.

The service was the only thing that out did the food. Everyone was kind and polite. Mahmoud was our favorite. We will be back.

The restaurant was clean and the location is great, very walkable area. Perfect for a quick lunch or dinner.

This is the worst service I have EVER seen in Citrus Park. There were people who came to the bar and waited until they were frustrated and left. Finally ordeeed the soup which was cold and tasteless. They have to realize there are other places to patronize in this area!

The wait to even be greeted and seat was ridiculous. We were told that the table was getting wiped down, upon sitting down you could see the condensation marks from the cups on the table so obviously they weren't wiped down. Or they did a really shitty job. Took another extra long wait just to see our waitress. After ordering our drinks, took another 5 minutes to get 3 drinks. Beer, coke and a kids apple juice. Once we got the drinks, they waitress brought a aluminum can of apple juice to my daughter who is not even 2...wtf is my daughter suppose to do with that, she sure has hell cant drink out of a can. We weren't given a cup or anything for her. After waiting AGAIN we watched as people came into the door and not one single employee went to the hostess stand to greet and seat any of them. They have a lack of common sense. The management is a sorry excuse of a manager because who the hell hired all those people and let that restaurant get so shitty. Hire new staff and new management who actually have a brain. Not To mention, it was Father's Day and it wasn't busy.
Cheesesteak Tacos. When at El Camino do what El Camino do......very tasty. My cousin thinks it is short rib and not steak. Either way they were tasty and it was happy hour prices!!

Not only does Freddy's have a great veggie burger and sundaes, but their customer service is wonderful. Everyone is always so nice and whenever I go through the drive-through with my dog, they ask if I want a pup cup. They give me a little vanilla ice cream in a cup for my dog, she loves it. I love it here and so does my dog, and we will continue to come!!
I love this place! Every time I go here I order something different and I've never been disappointed! The atmosphere is so fun and the staff is friendly. This is my favorite place to go get brunch.
This place is doing Dine In but the windows are wide open allowing plenty of fresh air. The food was amazing, came out quick and always eat a 1/2 order of beignets while you wait.

Really enjoyed the atmosphere and concept of this restaurant. Service was fantastic and everyone was friendly. I had the fried oyster tacos which were good. Kids menu was good as well.  Overall good experience.

I've never given 5 stars before but East Bistro is the beast of all Mediterranean joints. BTW, this is not my first run on Mediterranean food. The chicken kabob plate was juicy and tender..straight-up delicious!!!!
The food here is absolute amazing!! We tried it after passing it looking for a beach spot and it has beatiful views of the ocean and the best seafood around!! Try the peal and eat shrimp!!!
Pizza tasted grate! Great customer service! Everyone was so nice and sweat. If you ever have a chance to go, go.

We ordered a simple 2 topping pizza following a Cardinals game. Was never given an estimated wait time during the ordering process and only found out in my email confirmation that it would take between 65-70 minutes. At the 1 hour 30 minute I  called to cancel because it was it just way too late to eat and they could have cared less I was cancelling. Based on that response I'd say it happens often. At this point I am concerned I will get charged and will then have to call and straighten it out

This PDQ is the only fast food restaurant that we've been to that constantly always wears their mask at the drive-through. The food is always fresh and hot and you get a speedy friendly service. Sometimes we come here just because we know the staff are following CDC guidelines and wearing mask properly.

We had been here years ago. Once we ate there we went back everyday during our vacation. Food absolutely the BEST. Service atmosphere wonderful. We are going to Orlando in 2 weeks an going to make a drive to Tampa just to eat here.

Not a great experience. Super bad part of town and stray dogs in the parking lot. Parking was limited, but tons of people there so we figured it must be good food. Told 25 min wait and it took an hour and 15 minutes before seating us. Sat us 2 at a table for 6 with open tables. Food was subpar, and charged for every little thing Like sour cream etc. Food didn't even come with rice and beans. Will not be back!

Two words: Corn Casserole 

Let's rewind...

This review is sponsored by the Procrastination Society, it's long overdue from my visit to Nashville back in September. 

Let's make it short and sweet...

This little strip mall seems to encompass a little bit of this and a little bit of that which is something for everyone. 

Earlier that morning we visited the Hot Yoga Studio and the breakfast eatery in the strip mall. So while we were returning to the car we could smell this place smoking it up early in the morning. 

Fast forward to dinner time...I think it might have been in the clouds as we went to another place to eat and were turned away because they said they were closing an hour early, viola, we ended up here. 

Service: family owned and they were so friendly 

Price: reasonable for a bbq joint, around $10-$15 per person with a drink

Food: as referred to at the beginning of the post, that corn casserole was delish, think I got shredded chicken which was good, house-made bbq sauce at the table, tried both, one with the jalapeño I liked better, oh I had the collard greens and they were pretty good as well. 

If we are ever back in Hendersonville, this is a place I'll be eating.
My hubby and I tried Mesh for first time. Love the Cunningham group of restaurants. Sat at bar. I bartender and service slow for drinks. Food was awesome.

FOOD POISONING 

I have ordered takeout from here 3 times in the last 2 months. It is apparently a staple Chinese restaurant in the Nashville area.

The first two times were very good. 

1st time-House Supreme

2nd time-Beef and Shrimp in Black Bean Sauce
Both times I believe I had "Hot and Sour" soup and spring rolls--all good...

3rd time & the reason for 1 star review--

"Chef Recommended" SEAFOOD Combination with XO Sauce/ 2 Egg-rolls (they threw in a random crab rangoon as a bonus?) / Egg Custard Steamed Bun

The sickest I've been in my life.
Within 4 hours of consuming the meal (I ate it within a half hour of picking up from the restaurant & it was not yet finished by the time I arrived) I became Violently Sick!

The entire event lasted for 3.5 days--within 5 hours of eating I had uncontrollable purging and inability to keep any fluid down for 4 hours until I fell asleep from exhaustion.
Issues persisted for 48 hours tho I was able to stomach fluids and bland foods after about 18 hrs.
I was completely symptom free from the FOOD POISONING after about 3.5 days.

I will not eat here again; and it taught me a lesson and unfortunately I am disinclined to food I used to enjoy very much for who knows how long.

My boyfriend and I were there Monday Morning (yesterday) as our last visit spot in PA. We stayed at the Homewood Suites Hotel and saw that this place was 5mins away after looking for a place to eat besides getting the food in the hotel. We were both very pleased with the staff and the great outdoor seating option! The food came out excellent and had great orange juice. The price is very reasonable, would definitely recommend to anyone in the area either as a resident, or a visitor like my boyfriend and I.
Everything was really good but they switched to a tasting menu which means you don't pick your own food. Luckily  we didn't get duck hearts or  anything to crazy.

Came from out of town to visit a friend and checked out this Vegan Spot. When we called over the phone to ask if it was BYOB they also informed us that the wait time would be 1 hour and 45 mins. Which was insane because when we arrived which was much earlier than the suggested wait time the restaurant was half empty. Don't understand why anyone would push clients out unnecessarily but definitely did not sit well with me. The decor was nice. Menu is nothing to really write home about, pretty basic vegan recipes seems like in the earlier days they had more interesting dishes. Had the Buffalo Cauliflower, which was soggy not crisp at all. Although the dip that accompanies it tasted good. Also, had the Mac and Cheese, they barely put any cheese on it tasted like bare macaroni. It was not at all like the cheesy ones pictured on Yelp (in hindsight wish I took a picture of this). When I told the waiter about this she brought more but failed to inform me that it cost extra, which would've been fine if there were cheese already in the said mac and "cheese" but there wasn't. These are very basic Vegan staples so I'm surprised that they could be done badly. I'm seeing that this place has had really good reviews and I don't know if maybe management has changed or something? But clearly there's a lack of consistency here. Personally wouldn't recommend it if you're vegan and in the area.

Osteria is one of my favorite happy hour spots in Philly. You can get massive thin crust personal pizzas for $6, pasta for $7, wine for $5, and cocktails for $6. Highly recommend to anyone in the Francisville area!

Chicken pho - broth had a refreshing, clean taste.  The chicken was very tender.  It came with side of citrus sauce to put into the pho!

BBQ Pork Bahnmi - the pork was tasty and the portion size was what I expected. All the ingredients were fresh.  The bread/roll was soft.

Sweet potato fries ($4.50) - fries were warm and came with a side of spicy mayo.  

Would I go back?  I wouldn't mind.  Wouldn't go out my way to go there.

FYI....place is BYO

Really nice and well done with the reservations and separation from other guests. We had calamari, bread board, Cesar salad, salmon, and chicken rice soup and desert. Each item was very good, service was great.
Great food and large drink selection. Sometimes hard to find a seat so best to call in advance and make reservations.

So this was my first time visit. We came for my sisters graduation tonight and we were all wanting to have a nice dinner. Well we show up and it takes a server 20 minutes to even acknowledge that we were there and even then it was to only ask if everyone was seated. We only had 12 people and we were waiting on 1 person. We then went to order appetizers and the waitress only took orders from half of the table. The other half wasn't able to order their appetizers until the first round even hit the table because the waitress was so inattentive. Our dirty plates sat on the table until the entrees came, the busses dropped plates and yelled "oh shit". Once appetizers were done I decided to time our entrees because everything was taking so long..... 37 minutes for our entrees to hit the table without the waitress coming by once. And this was 37 minutes AFTER the SECOND round of appetizers were finished. Food was ok nothing special and way over priced. We then were rushed to get dessert because apparently they make desserts fresh and it takes 20 min minimum and they were closing. So now all of a sudden we needed to hurry up and leave because they were closed. I'm not one to ever say something on yelp but I worked in fine dining industry for years and if I spend this kind of money on a meal I expect something a little better than what was given. Terrible service, boring food, overpriced, probably won't be returning.

I don't know where to begin. The service was awesome and the food was even better. I was excited to see that they have so many vegan options I didn't feel left out at all. I got the vegan double cheeseburger with the vegan mozzarella cheese and OMG. Every bite it just got better and better. Honestly I was eating with my eyes closed lol! The curly fries were the perfect touch as well. Highly recommend!

THE BEST RESTAURANT!! The bar tenders are the best. The owner is amazing. The food is delicious.
Family friendly!!
Very very enjoyable bar... Love the architecture and it's proximity to the waterfront... The restaurant food selection was quite nice as well. Overall a lovely time.

They had my ingredients missing and did not bother telling me! When I asked them for a credit they said I have to Email. What a scam. I was a pickup and they did not bother telling me. They thought I would just go home and realize and it would be too late to ask for a refund. Unfortunately for them, I was still in the mall and eating it and went back for a refund and they told me to go email and they wouldn't be able to refund me at the store, which is truly a pain. Their app allows them to charge you for things they don't have but yet can't refund you if they don't have them and on and on top of it they don't even tell you that the ingredients are missing.

I got the tropical chicken salad sandwich with chips and black beans. Not sure which was the mistake. The food choice or getting it togo, because the experience was overall pretty awful for my first time. 

1st - yes I saw the signs for where to order, but it was my first time going here and no seeing anyone under those signs behind the counter, and only seeing one person at a register....that's exactly where I went to order. She got a serious attitude with me over it, even after I apologized and said I had never been there before. Lord help me, because I asked if the spiced sweet potatoes were cut up or mashed and apparently it was an issue, even there was literally no one in line behind me. (Mashed by the way...)

2nd - I work less than 5 minutes away and when I got back to my desk, opened the box...HUGE MESS. Soggy chips from sitting in the black beans and the beans were all over. Okay fine, no biggie, whatever. 

3rd - black beans have ZERO flavor even with the sour cream and onions in them. Oh and they were crunchy (took a bite w/ no onion). That's sad. As I mentioned, half the chips were soggy. Then the part I was really excited about was the sandwich. Completely fell apart when I tried to eat it. Found like 4 or 5 TINY pieces of pineapple...and in general it didn't have a whole lot of taste either. Definitely not a tropical one. 

4th - the fruit tea is fabulous (so good job there I guess)

Overall, very disappointing, underwhelming and just all around bad experience.
HOLY SHISH KEBAB this place is awesome. Highly recommend the lamb gyro and Greek fries! Love the house made sauces.

Can't even describe what a nasty and dank feel this hole has! It's like a dungeon with no windows. Rude and ignoring staff, too. Pastrami sandwich is full of fat and grizzle. Weakest drinks in town! Save your money!!! Skip this dungeon. It's like a cross between an old man's nursing home and high school detention.
Every time we go through Santa Barbara we stop here. This food is excellent. their salsas are fantastic!!  highly recommend
